subject: Now THAT is a throw
body:
Now THAT is a throw. A good bola wraps a small dragon up nice and snug for a while. A full-grown Nightmare, though, snaps it like knitting in two breaths. So throw, then do the important bit, which is running. I ran from a Nightmare once and lost a boot. The leg came off later, THAT was a separate occasion.

Gobber
